scripts.prep: pnpm --filter @nuvora/shared run build && pnpm --filter @nuvora/api run db:generate
scripts.dev: pnpm run prep && pnpm --parallel --filter @nuvora/api --filter @nuvora/web run dev
scripts.lint: pnpm run prep && pnpm -r --if-present run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run prep && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run prep && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.build: pnpm run prep && pnpm -r --if-present run build
